svg.title: Diabetes complications split by time: acute emergencies sorted by glucose and acidosis into diabetic ketoacidosis, hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state or hypoglycemia, and chronic damage sorted into retinopathy, nephropathy and neuropathy (prevented by glucose control) and macrovascular disease (prevented by blood pressure, LDL and smoking control); each column gives presentation, numbered tests or screens and treatment or prevention in order

svg.text: Sick-day rules: prevent the next DKA or HHS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • type 1: keep SOME insulin even when not eating · check glucose AND urine ketones often

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • type 2: check glucose often · STOP SGLT2 inhibitors, diuretics, metformin while vomiting or with diarrhea · some insulin is safe
